Punjab Assembly Passes Resolution Against E20 Fuel Policy

The Punjab Assembly has passed a resolution opposing the Centre's E20 fuel policy. This policy, which mandates a blend of 20% ethanol with petrol, is reported to be impacting Punjab's pre-owned automobile market, estimated at Rs 1,000 crore. The resolution signifies the state assembly's stance against the implementation of this fuel blend.
